workload_shapes_exercised: CLI lifecycle: reload, unload, commit, abort, diff, status, snapshot, travel, mount, unmount, watch
mounted filesystem operations: create, read, write, seek, readdir, rename, mkdir, rmdir, symlink, delete, fallocate, concurrent operations
internal state semantics: journal format, commit/abort, snapshot, travel, rename resolution, dentry interposition, ownership, consistency
permission semantics: allow, deny, read-only, ask, hide, live rules, metadata operation gating, open-flag handling, ioctl gating

caveats.not_main_branch: The passing mounted e2e run is on the public compat branch, not the main checkout.
caveats.not_private_benchmarks: The unavailable umbrella agent/perf evaluation submodules remain unreproduced.

caveats.clock_skew_warning: The guest kmod build reported small clock-skew warnings on the 9p share, but the final module build and test run completed with status 0.
